title: externalize all widgets
body:
we should externalize and develop all widgets in separated modules

To ease development, we can have an `npm run link-all-widgets` that will clone, checkout master and npm-link every known widget.

So that we can easily develop them using the `npm run dev` task.

comments.body:
=> No, it would complexify the `dev` workflow and thus slow us down.

cc @redox @pixelastic @bobylito 

This does not prevents us to easilyt collaborate of course, since when developping a widget you only need to work in widget/*
I'm happy with keeping a single project with subdirs :+1:
It may be a good thing later on, but it's really too early right now, this would slowwwwwww down
